name: Colonial Furniture

about:
Colonial Furniture operates from Freeburg, Pennsylvania, as a family-owned manufacturer of solid cherry furniture. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or the names of its founders. It began as a maker of quality solid cherry furniture, with a focus on compatibility with Pennsylvania House Furniture lines.

The company produces a range of solid cherry furniture for the bedroom, dining room, and living room. Offerings include beds, dressers, nightstands, sideboards, dining tables, chairs, bookcases, TV cabinets, and specialty items such as hooked bed rails and wood bed slats. Colonial Furniture maintains a factory outlet store at its Freeburg facility, where customers can view and purchase pieces by appointment.

Colonial Furniture serves residential customers seeking solid cherry furniture, including those looking for pieces that match Pennsylvania House collections. The factory outlet model allows direct sales to consumers, while the company’s emphasis on solid wood construction appeals to buyers avoiding veneer or composite alternatives.

The business highlights its family-owned structure and financial stability as foundations for consistent quality. By manufacturing exclusively in solid cherry, the company positions itself as a source for durable, heirloom-grade furniture rather than mass-market imitations.
